source_path.Description: Path to the source physio recording relative to the --input root (POSIX separators).

status.Description: Per-file processing outcome, regenerated every run.

Levels.CONVERTED: phys2bids read the file and its BIDS _physio.tsv.gz/.json file(s) were written to the proper path.
Levels.UNKNOWN_NAME: Valid physio but participant_id is blank, so it was converted into tmp_phys2bids/ under its input basename; fill in participant_id and re-run.
Levels.DATES_DISAGREE: Converted, but the filename date disagreed with the last-modified date; the last-modified date was used for session_id.
Levels.NOT_PHYSIO: Matched a supported extension but could not be loaded as physiological data.
Levels.READER_MISSING: The optional reader package phys2bids needs for this format is not installed.
Levels.CONVERT_ERROR: phys2bids raised while converting, or produced no .tsv.gz output.
Levels.MISSING: A file present in a prior physioscans.tsv is no longer found under --input; its row and edits are preserved.

participant_id.Description: BIDS participant identifier (sub-<label>) best-guessed from the first underscore token of the input filename. Editable: user edits are preserved across runs. Blank when the filename did not start with a participant label (the file is then staged with status UNKNOWN_NAME).

session_id.Description: BIDS session identifier (ses-<label>) best-guessed from the acquisition date found among the filename tokens, falling back to the file's last-modified date. Editable; setting it resolves a DATES_DISAGREE flag.

datatype.Description: BIDS datatype directory the recording is placed under (e.g. func). Not encoded in the filename, so it defaults to func; change it for non-functional recordings. Editable.

task.Description: BIDS task entity (task-<label>). Not encoded in physio filenames, so blank by default; fill in to add it to the BIDS name. Editable.

acquisition.Description: BIDS acquisition entity (acq-<label>) built from any filename tokens that are neither the participant, the date, nor the run. Editable.

run.Description: BIDS run entity (run-<index>), zero-padded to two digits, parsed from a trailing 4-digit filename token. Editable.

n_channels.Description: Number of channels phys2bids reported for the recording (its ch_amount, which includes the leading time channel). Blank for files that were not loaded as physio.

sampling_frequencies.Description: Unique channel sampling frequencies in hertz, ascending, comma-separated (e.g. 1000,500). A single value for the common single-frequency case. Aligned position-by-position with sample_count and duration_seconds.

sample_count.Description: Number of samples per sampling frequency, comma-separated and aligned with sampling_frequencies (the longest channel recorded at each frequency). Blank for files that were not loaded as physio.

duration_seconds.Description: Acquisition duration in seconds at 0.001 s precision, computed as sample_count / sampling_frequency, comma-separated and aligned with sampling_frequencies. Blank for files that were not loaded as physio.

output_files.Description: Converted BIDS _physio.tsv.gz output path(s) relative to the --output root, comma-separated; multiple when phys2bids split the recording by frequency. Blank when nothing was written.

bids_name.Description: The portion of each output file's basename between the sub-<label>[_ses-<label>]_ prefix and the .tsv.gz extension, comma-separated and aligned with output_files. Regenerated every run from the current output(s); blank when there are none.

rename.Description: Free-text field for an end-user to record a corrected bids_name when the file needs renaming. Only applies when the source produced exactly one output file (a multi-frequency source's rename is ignored with a warning, since it cannot unambiguously target one file). Empty by default.

recommend_for_use.Description: Whether the recording is recommended for use. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

Levels.TRUE: The recording is recommended for use.
Levels.FALSE: The recording is not recommended for use.

complete.Description: Whether the recording was acquired at its complete, as-intended length. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

usable.Description: Whether the recording is usable at all. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

qc_rating.Description: Acquisition quality-control rating. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

rating_reason.Description: Free-text reason for the qc_rating, open to any string of any length. Empty by default.

qc_notes.Description: Free-text notes about the quality control not captured by other fields, open to any string of any length. Empty by default.
